rationale: This is the narrow corrective successor to failed candidate 0.141. The FSK ISR is armed only after the one-time TFT redraw, preventing the accepted 512-edge ring from overflowing before the service loop can drain it. Quick Self-Test replaces its obsolete pre-catalog 128 KiB single heap floor with explicit current-product gates of 80 KiB free and 64 KiB historical minimum. The existing Full/Guided sequence, receive-only drivers, storage formats, board profile, partitions and build flags remain unchanged.
required_host_checks: full host/source/docs suite in tracked-evidence mode
Full/Guided plan-v10 native result and both heap-floor negative cases
deferred FSK ISR attachment and no-TX source contract
exact firmware build and resource budget
required_hil_scenarios: one public Full/Guided delta run through nRF24, CC1101 spectrum, OOK, FSK and IR receive smoke
FSK ISR queue armed after static redraw, drained without overflow and all S5 receive checks passed
Quick and final Full reports pass both explicit current-product heap gates
disposable scratch removed with product CID, generation and observations unchanged
zero radio TX commands, input drops and final ownership
